l.bl: Zwischen Wayanawassan und dem Südmeer ist der
große Chrystallberg/welcher so hoch/daß er sich in die Wolken verbirgt/
und so gech/daß niemand darüber kommen kan/ 10. Tag sihet man den
Berg/ eh man darzu komt/und wann die Sonn scheint/kan man wegen
des Glanzes gegenschein nicht dargegen wandlen.

main_text.l: Tu interim, Benevole Lector, ea quæ minùs ἀκριβῶς[?], sed
παχυ-λῶς[?] & rudi Minerva à me dicta sunt, pro humanitate & benevolentia
Tua corrige, omissa supple, reliqua tanquam leves conjecturas benignè
accipe. Meliora, favente Numine, maturescentibus studiis & annis, me-
liores & perfectiores cum tempore redditi, forte dabimus,
Μόνῳ τῷ Θεῷ ἡ δόξα.

page.notes: Greek words in the penultimate paragraph ("ἀκριβῶς", "παχυ-λῶς") are doubtful at the small print and marked [?]. The German sentences in black letter are transcribed as read; the spelling of "Chrystallberg" and "gech" is as printed. The signature "I 3" is uncertain. Show-through from the other side and a handwritten number on the right edge were left out. No running head or catchword is printed.
